t: Fortress 2.5Ltr Brilliant White Soft Sheen Emulsion Paint is a high-performance, water-based coating for interior walls and ceilings. This durable emulsion is formulated for high-traffic environments, making it ideal for kitchen and bathroom applications. It provides excellent moisture and stain resistance, actively protecting painted surfaces from mould. The soft sheen finish is fully washable, offering 14m² coverage per litre and drying to touch in 2-4 hours, with recoating possible in 4 hours for efficient project turnaround.
